name: logibee-ai
description: Logibee AI provides authenticated, read-only shipment search, current status, operational details and shipment history through ChatGPT for authorized Logibee users.

interface.longDescription: Logibee AI provides authenticated, read-only shipment search, current status, operational details and shipment history through ChatGPT for authorized Logibee users.
defaultPrompt: Find my shipment by tracking number.
Show the current status of my shipment.
Show the history of my shipment.

positive.description: Find a shipment using its exact tracking number.
positive.expected_behavior: Return shipment 1792405825667 with canonical status Delivered and an authorized, AI-safe shipment summary.

positive.description: Retrieve the current operational details of a shipment.
positive.prompt: Show the current details for shipment 1792405825555.
positive.expected_behavior: Return approved operational details for shipment 1792405825555 with canonical status Picked. Do not expose sensitive information.

positive.description: Review a shipment's recorded status and event history.
positive.prompt: Show the chronological history for shipment 1792405825758.
positive.expected_behavior: Return 12 available chronological events ending with Delivered. No invented events or proof URLs.

positive.description: Explain a shipment's current status in simple language.
positive.prompt: Explain the current status of shipment 1792405825601 in simple terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain the canonical Picked status using only available shipment information. Exact assistant wording is not required.

positive.prompt: Briefly summarize the lifecycle of shipment 1792405825786.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize nine available chronological events ending in Delivered. Do not invent events.

negative.description: Shipment creation is unsupported because Logibee AI is read-only.
negative.prompt: Create a new shipment for me.

negative.description: Shipment cancellation is unsupported because no write tool is exposed.
Shipment modification is unsupported because no write tool is exposed.
negative.prompt: Change the delivery date for shipment 1792405825555 to tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: Logibee AI provides read-only shipment information and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release of Logibee AI with authenticated, read-only shipment search, shipment details, and shipment timeline tools.
